name: Claude AI LINE Chatbot
description: Connects LINE messaging to Anthropic Claude AI. Receives LINE webhook, generates contextual reply with Claude, and sends response back to LINE user.

blockers.detail: Chat Model provider anthropic is not supported by the current node catalog

setup: "Ask Claude": the original provider "anthropic" and model are preserved. Select a supported Chat Model provider and matching model, or add its adapter in Yantra before running.
"LINE Webhook" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

Workflow secret LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN: LINE channel access token for api.line.me (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers, llm_system_e60179b7f8.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /claude-line-bot). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.

"Ask Claude" called the Anthropic API (claude-opus-4-5) over HTTP; it now runs on LLMChain with a Chat Model and provider connector credential, and later steps read the answer text instead of the provider's JSON.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
